{
  "project_id": "P-GTM-SmartPublicFinances",
  "risks": [
    {
      "risk_id": "R01",
      "description": "Delay in establishing the Project Implementation Unit (PIU) and Project Operational Manual (POM) could block disbursements.",
      "category": "schedule",
      "likelihood": 4,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Set a fast‑track recruitment schedule, assign senior Bank liaison to monitor PIU set‑up, and link milestone payments to PIU approval.",
      "evidence": "No withdrawal shall be made ... until the Borrower has established the PIU, satisfactory to the Bank."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R02",
      "description": "Cyber‑attacks on government portals may disrupt the PFM information ecosystem and compromise data integrity.",
      "category": "technical",
      "likelihood": 4,
      "impact": 5,
      "mitigation": "Implement the ISMS and SOC as planned, conduct regular penetration testing, and provide staff training on incident response.",
      "evidence": "Superintendency of Tax Administration faced over 8,000 cyberattacks in 2021; Guatecompras and SICOIN stopped working due to a cyber‑attack in Nov 2023."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R03",
      "description": "Fragmented legacy PFM systems and limited interoperability could cause implementation delays and data inconsistencies.",
      "category": "technical",
      "likelihood": 4,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Adopt the defined enterprise architecture, phase integration of core and peripheral systems, and enforce common data standards.",
      "evidence": "Core PFM information systems suffer from fragmentation, obsolescence, and weak institutional support; limited interoperability leads to manual processes."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R04",
      "description": "Insufficient institutional capacity and high staff turnover may jeopardize reform sustainability.",
      "category": "organizational",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Launch a structured capacity‑building program, create career paths for data analysts, and offer retention incentives for key staff.",
      "evidence": "A common reason for failure ... is the lack of adequate preparation and institutional stability within the implementing agency."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R05",
      "description": "Low adoption of gender‑responsive budgeting limits inclusive outcomes and may not meet gender objectives.",
      "category": "stakeholder",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Strengthen gender‑budget tagging guidelines, provide training to municipalities, and tie funding incentives to gender‑tagged budget adoption.",
      "evidence": "Only 0.6% of the national budget was tagged with a gender focus; only 112 of 340 municipalities linked their budget to the CPEG."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R06",
      "description": "Extreme weather events could damage ICT infrastructure and interrupt PFM services.",
      "category": "environmental",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Deploy climate‑resilient data centers, establish backup sites, and integrate BCMS procedures for disaster response.",
      "evidence": "75% of the population at risk from floods, droughts, landslides; climate‑related hazards may affect capacity of systems."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R07",
      "description": "Coordination failures with IMF and IDB partners may delay IPSAS implementation and data integration.",
      "category": "stakeholder",
      "likelihood": 2,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Create a joint steering committee, formalize MoUs, and hold monthly coordination meetings to track progress.",
      "evidence": "IMF is leading IPSAS strategy; IDB is improving data quality and integration within SIAF."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R08",
      "description": "Underestimation of ICT procurement costs could lead to budget overruns.",
      "category": "financial",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Prepare detailed cost estimates, include a contingency reserve, and enforce competitive bidding with life‑cycle cost analysis.",
      "evidence": "Minor climate risks ... procurement of hardware may arise; project will incorporate life‑cycle requirements and energy efficiency standards."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R09",
      "description": "Limited analytical capacity hampers effective use of data analytics for decision‑making.",
      "category": "organizational",
      "likelihood": 4,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Establish a dedicated data analytics unit, deliver training programs, and define career pathways for data professionals.",
      "evidence": "Guatemala’s use of analytics is limited; lack of structured career development for data analysts in the public sector."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R10",
      "description": "A decline in remittance flows could reduce VAT revenue, tightening fiscal space.",
      "category": "financial",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Diversify revenue sources, strengthen tax administration, and build fiscal buffers to absorb external shocks.",
      "evidence": "Remittances represent 19.4% of GDP; any decline could reduce VAT collections, which generate 47.8% of net income."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R11",
      "description": "Complex World Bank procurement procedures and limited local capacity may cause procurement delays.",
      "category": "schedule",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Develop early procurement plans, provide capacity‑building workshops for staff, and use streamlined procedures where permissible.",
      "evidence": "Procurement will be carried out following World Bank procedure; procurement arrangements, capacity assessment, risks, and mitigation are detailed in Annex 1."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R12",
      "description": "Erosion of political commitment could undermine reform continuity.",
      "category": "political_regulatory",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Secure a high‑level champion, embed reforms in legal statutes, and link performance incentives to reform milestones.",
      "evidence": "Need strong, sustained commitment from senior government leadership; lack of preparation and institutional stability cited as failure reasons."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R13",
      "description": "Inadequate monitoring and evaluation may prevent timely detection of implementation issues.",
      "category": "organizational",
      "likelihood": 2,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Implement a robust M&E framework with real‑time dashboards and conduct independent mid‑term evaluations.",
      "evidence": "PIU will establish a project monitoring system; semiannual progress reports will guide adjustments."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R14",
      "description": "Business Continuity Management System (BCMS) may not be fully operational, risking service interruption during disasters.",
      "category": "technical",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Develop BCMS per ISO 22301, conduct regular drills, and update continuity plans after each test.",
      "evidence": "Subcomponent 2.5 will develop a BCMS following ISO 22301 to ensure response to disruptive incidents, including climate‑related events."
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R15",
      "description": "PFM governance framework may remain ineffective, leading to fragmented decision‑making.",
      "category": "stakeholder",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Define clear governance roles, hold regular coordination meetings, and enforce accountability mechanisms.",
      "evidence": "Formal PFM Governance framework established (Yes/No) – target Yes by 2025."
    }
  ]
}

risks.description: Delay in establishing the Project Implementation Unit (PIU) and Project Operational Manual (POM) could block disbursements.
risks.mitigation: Set a fast‑track recruitment schedule, assign senior Bank liaison to monitor PIU set‑up, and link milestone payments to PIU approval.
risks.evidence: No withdrawal shall be made ... until the Borrower has established the PIU, satisfactory to the Bank.

risks.description: Cyber‑attacks on government portals may disrupt the PFM information ecosystem and compromise data integrity.
risks.mitigation: Implement the ISMS and SOC as planned, conduct regular penetration testing, and provide staff training on incident response.
risks.evidence: Superintendency of Tax Administration faced over 8,000 cyberattacks in 2021; Guatecompras and SICOIN stopped working due to a cyber‑attack in Nov 2023.

risks.description: Fragmented legacy PFM systems and limited interoperability could cause implementation delays and data inconsistencies.
risks.mitigation: Adopt the defined enterprise architecture, phase integration of core and peripheral systems, and enforce common data standards.
risks.evidence: Core PFM information systems suffer from fragmentation, obsolescence, and weak institutional support; limited interoperability leads to manual processes.

risks.description: Insufficient institutional capacity and high staff turnover may jeopardize reform sustainability.
risks.mitigation: Launch a structured capacity‑building program, create career paths for data analysts, and offer retention incentives for key staff.
risks.evidence: A common reason for failure ... is the lack of adequate preparation and institutional stability within the implementing agency.

risks.description: Low adoption of gender‑responsive budgeting limits inclusive outcomes and may not meet gender objectives.
risks.mitigation: Strengthen gender‑budget tagging guidelines, provide training to municipalities, and tie funding incentives to gender‑tagged budget adoption.
risks.evidence: Only 0.6% of the national budget was tagged with a gender focus; only 112 of 340 municipalities linked their budget to the CPEG.

risks.description: Extreme weather events could damage ICT infrastructure and interrupt PFM services.
risks.mitigation: Deploy climate‑resilient data centers, establish backup sites, and integrate BCMS procedures for disaster response.
risks.evidence: 75% of the population at risk from floods, droughts, landslides; climate‑related hazards may affect capacity of systems.

risks.description: Coordination failures with IMF and IDB partners may delay IPSAS implementation and data integration.
risks.mitigation: Create a joint steering committee, formalize MoUs, and hold monthly coordination meetings to track progress.
risks.evidence: IMF is leading IPSAS strategy; IDB is improving data quality and integration within SIAF.

risks.description: Underestimation of ICT procurement costs could lead to budget overruns.
risks.mitigation: Prepare detailed cost estimates, include a contingency reserve, and enforce competitive bidding with life‑cycle cost analysis.
risks.evidence: Minor climate risks ... procurement of hardware may arise; project will incorporate life‑cycle requirements and energy efficiency standards.

risks.description: Limited analytical capacity hampers effective use of data analytics for decision‑making.
risks.mitigation: Establish a dedicated data analytics unit, deliver training programs, and define career pathways for data professionals.
risks.evidence: Guatemala’s use of analytics is limited; lack of structured career development for data analysts in the public sector.

risks.description: A decline in remittance flows could reduce VAT revenue, tightening fiscal space.
risks.mitigation: Diversify revenue sources, strengthen tax administration, and build fiscal buffers to absorb external shocks.
risks.evidence: Remittances represent 19.4% of GDP; any decline could reduce VAT collections, which generate 47.8% of net income.

risks.description: Complex World Bank procurement procedures and limited local capacity may cause procurement delays.
risks.mitigation: Develop early procurement plans, provide capacity‑building workshops for staff, and use streamlined procedures where permissible.
risks.evidence: Procurement will be carried out following World Bank procedure; procurement arrangements, capacity assessment, risks, and mitigation are detailed in Annex 1.

risks.description: Erosion of political commitment could undermine reform continuity.
risks.mitigation: Secure a high‑level champion, embed reforms in legal statutes, and link performance incentives to reform milestones.
risks.evidence: Need strong, sustained commitment from senior government leadership; lack of preparation and institutional stability cited as failure reasons.

risks.description: Inadequate monitoring and evaluation may prevent timely detection of implementation issues.
risks.mitigation: Implement a robust M&E framework with real‑time dashboards and conduct independent mid‑term evaluations.
risks.evidence: PIU will establish a project monitoring system; semiannual progress reports will guide adjustments.

risks.description: Business Continuity Management System (BCMS) may not be fully operational, risking service interruption during disasters.
risks.mitigation: Develop BCMS per ISO 22301, conduct regular drills, and update continuity plans after each test.
risks.evidence: Subcomponent 2.5 will develop a BCMS following ISO 22301 to ensure response to disruptive incidents, including climate‑related events.

risks.description: PFM governance framework may remain ineffective, leading to fragmented decision‑making.
risks.mitigation: Define clear governance roles, hold regular coordination meetings, and enforce accountability mechanisms.
risks.evidence: Formal PFM Governance framework established (Yes/No) – target Yes by 2025.
